steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each record is placed by its hazard score and whether immediate action is recorded.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: stop: one incident has no immediate action

findings.title: Incident with no immediate action recorded
Hazard with no score
findings.fix: Score the hazard under the rulebook

findings.title: Observation with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner and a close date

outcome.notChecked: whether the controls work on the floor; whether people follow the procedure; the jurisdiction's requirements, which a qualified adviser confirms; records that were never made.

pros: Checks a hazard with no score under the shared rulebook; an observation with no action, owner or close date; an incident with no immediate containment, no root cause, no corrective action, no owner, or no ve.
cons: Not checked: whether the controls work on the floor; whether people follow the procedure; the jurisdiction's requirements, which a qualified adviser confirms; records that were never made.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-core-safety-risk skill on the records for this review.
